data.name: Distracting Shot
data.description: A bolt ace can spend 1 grit point and choose to miss a target that she could normally attack within her range with a crossbow attack. When she does, the target loses its Dexterity bonus to AC (if any) for 1 round.

raw_tokens.value: Bolt Ace Class Feature.Gunslinger Class Feature.SpecialQuality.Extraordinary

A bolt ace can spend 1 grit point and choose to miss a target that she could normally attack within her range with a crossbow attack. When she does, the target loses its Dexterity bonus to AC (if any) for 1 round.
